Technology Commons is an open teaching site for secondary technology education.

The goal is practical:

> **Learn by designing, building, testing, explaining, and improving real work.**

The site brings course lessons, project guides, reference material, technical tools, and research into one place that students can use during class and continue using outside it.

## Courses

Technology Commons currently supports three course groups:

- **TAS2O:** Exploring Technologies
- **TEJ3M / TEJ4M:** Computer Engineering Technology
- **TTJ3C / TTJ4C:** Transportation Technology

Each course will have its own lesson sequence and sidebar while sharing common resources, tools, and design-process language.

## NICE Design Process

Projects use NICE as a repeatable engineering design cycle:

**N -> I -> C -> E -> N**

**Needs & Necessities** define what the design must do and what matters most.

**Investigate & Inquire** develops questions, research, constraints, observations, and possible approaches.

**Create & Communicate** turns ideas into sketches, code, CAD, prototypes, fabricated parts, tests, and explanations.

**Evaluate** compares the result with the original requirements, records evidence, and identifies what should change next.

Evaluation feeds back into the next cycle instead of ending the process.

## Open Course Materials

Technology Commons is being built as a reusable commons rather than a closed class website. Course materials should be understandable to students first, while still being useful to educators who want to inspect, adapt, or extend them.

The source for this site is available on GitHub.
